VERDICT: weak

Evidence relied on: DD-48211:ticket_missing. No order ticket is on file (payout_row:7), so I can't compare the claimed Acai Bowl (Large) against what was prepared.

The pickup-timestamp check recorded nothing, because there is no ticket ready time. The repeat-claimant check also recorded nothing. No other evidence supports the dispute.

The final `get_case` shows the win probability fell from 60% to **35%**. Confidence is 35 and the case is flagged weak. The only support is the memory that 2 of 3 similar past cases were won, which isn't evidence about this order.

Note saved to `/notes/DD-48211-evidence.md`.
